People around David often share different ideas about the swimming pool. The experience taught David more than any book could. On Monday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. In fact, don't say mean things to your classmates.
Little by little, things began to change. The ping-pong room has become an important part of daily life. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. For example, dial in five minutes early.

Eva advised David to try drawing as a new hobby. David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. Also, running makes your heartbeat faster.
